Description
Investing in precious metals can be daunting and confusing for new buyers, so Bullion Trading LLC is here to support you with your investment. Silver bars are vouched to be the best investment for 2026, and hence, we present you with the stunning
1 Kilo Scottsdale Stacker Silver Bar
produced by the renowned Scottsdale Mint, now available at
Bullion Trading LLC.
Scottsdale Mint is well-known as a private mint committed to quality and consistency in its manufacturing process. Their Kilo Scottsdale Stacker is the most popular and appreciated bar for its sturdy design, and security is produced keeping vault storage in mind with .999 silver content. The stacker bars are meant for easy and secure stacking for long-term storage.
You can secure your investment by purchasing this 1 Kilo Scottsdale Stacker Silver Bar that comes with protective wrapping and is delivered in a discreet shipping package from Bullion Trading LLC.
Design of 1 Kilo Scottsdale Stacker Silver Bar
The stacker bar is popular for its one-of-a-kind stacking design, inscribed with unique serial numbers on each bar. The bar is designed with a raised face on the observer and beveled edges that perfectly fit the reverse cutout to form a neat stack.
The design on the obverse features a prominent Scottsdale Mint hallmark. It exhibits a front-facing famous lion head of a stoic alpha male lion with a flowy mane and a crown on his head. It is engraved with the mint name, purity, weight, and the US national motto, “In God We Trust.”
The reverse features a smaller Scottsdale logo on the center of the bar with a unique serial number assigned to the bar at the bottom. The design has a unique swirling design moving inwards towards the logo.
Main Highlights of 1 Kilo Scottsdale Stacker Silver Bar
One-of-a-kind stackable design
Each bar is allocated with a unique serial number.
Contains .9999 fine silver
Observe design has the Scottsdale Mint logo along with the US motto.
The reverse design has a smaller Scottsdale logo at the center, and a swirled pattern fills the field to prevent forgery.
Bar is delivered in a protective wrapping material.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs
